notes.text:
CHG_INT: U5 BQ25628 ~INT -> U4 IO0 (R-V3-08)
  open drain, 256 us low pulse (SLUSEG4C 8.3.8.3)
  LP_GPIO0: also wakes the chip from deep sleep
EXP_INT: U17 TCA6408A ~INT -> U4 IO1 (R-V3-02)
  touch P4 + ACC_INT P5, held until read (SCPS192E 8.3.3)
  LP_GPIO1: also wakes the chip from deep sleep
Pull-ups: CONTROLLER pull-up row, 100K each
  EXP_INT R61 (R-V3-06), CHG_INT R62 (R-V3-08)
NAND CS: U4 IO7, was U17 P2 (R-V3-03)
32 kHz crystal removed (R-V3-01); IO15 now unused (R-V3-08)
